focus: Release-coverage and UX pass: attribute v4.0.0.4 and 0.6-0.10, run validate.sh --strict on /tmp copies of a Level 1 and a phase-parent packet, and exercise lookup-trigger-index.mjs with a typo flag, an empty prompt and an unknown flag.

graphEvents.label: Do the spec-kit tool messages name the fix
Trigger lookup returns score-0 hits with exit 0 unless --scoring-only
validate.sh --strict reports PASSED while SOURCE_TAGS is skipped to warn

label: The trigger lookup answers hit to a query nothing matches: a typo'd query returns 20 candidates all scored 0.000 with exit 0, while the same query under --json --scoring-only returns no results and exit 1; the score-0 filter sits inside the scoringOnly branch only, so the caller's no-hit signal depends on a flag.

validate.sh --strict prints RESULT: PASSED while SOURCE_TAGS reports that it could not run: outside a git repository the rule degrades to warn and returns success, and the RESULT line is derived from report.passed alone; the same run shows the mirror defect, where a copy fails GENERATED_METADATA_INTEGRITY and SPEC_DOC_INTEGRITY only because it sits outside the path its generated metadata names, so there is no portable way to validate a copy.

The v4.0.0.4 note omits the only spec-kit code change in its window: the placeholder scan now skips research/ and review/ (commit 2c761d5e36, +8 lines), a behaviour change that decides whether any deep-research packet passes the placeholder rule, and no v4.0.0.x note mentions it.

The repair hint prints a cwd-relative --folder path (../../../../../tmp/l14ux/l1) that resolves only from the directory the validator ran in, re-introducing the work the hint exists to remove; report.folder already carries the absolute folder.

Both tools that refuse an unknown flag withhold the accepted set: create.sh prints Error: unknown option and stops, and the lookup prints unknown argument: --bogus-flag with exit 2 and no usage block, so a misspelling leaves the reader to open the script.

The series-parent hint silently drops any recent packet that lacks graph-metadata.json derived.created_at or description.json, so the very sibling most likely to overlap new work (a hand-authored packet) never appears, while the hint still asks the reader to compare against its list.
One phase-parent strict run printed both a pass and a warn for GRAPH_METADATA_CHILD_DRIFT over the same packet, with the warn naming three children that were present on disk.

Path-limited git log for the v4.0.0.6 to v4.0.0.10 window shows no system-spec-kit or speckit code change beyond trigger-index rebuilds and documentation, so those five notes changed nothing in scope.

A research iteration must cite at least ten path:line tags drawn from code read in that iteration; this iteration cites lookup-trigger-index.mjs, check-source-tags.sh, orchestrator.ts, create.sh, check-placeholders.sh and validate.sh.
